product.olivetti-m6-850.summary: The EISA tower in the M6 range with a i486DX2 · 50 MHz.
product.olivetti-m6-850.history: Olivetti included it among the EISA M6 towers.
product.olivetti-m6-850.architecture: The processor sits on a dedicated card. The card plugs into the motherboard and includes 256 KB of L2 cache.
product.olivetti-m6-850.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m6-850.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m6-850.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 6
product.olivetti-m6-850.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.2 · rev. 2.3.
